label: Trailer Cinematográfico (45s) · Revolução Solar (Solarpunk & Distopia)
description: Trailer de ficção científica solarpunk em 16:9: megacidades verticais cobertas por biomas suspensos, tempestades de areia dourada cobrindo painéis solares gigantescos e aeronaves planadoras ao entardecer.
resources: sound design de vento solar e energia

scenes.prompt: Solarpunk sci-fi trailer cinematography in 16:9. Extreme wide shot of a colossal terracotta and white vertical megacity rising from a desert basin. Spiraling botanical gardens and cascading green sky-forests hang between immense solar-harvesting glass arches under a radiant golden sun. 35mm cinema lens, rich warm amber lighting. Non-verbal sound design: expansive desert wind roar and deep harmonic energy hum. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: QUANDO O SOL SE TORNOU A ÚNICA LEI.
scenes.onScreenText: QUANDO O SOL SE TORNOU A ÚNICA LEI

scenes.prompt: Solarpunk sci-fi trailer cinematography in 16:9. Macro shot of bio-photovoltaic leaves unfurling in slow motion, absorbing sunlight with glowing cyan micro-capillaries. Micro dust particles drift through golden atmospheric rays. Non-verbal sound design: organic vegetal rustle and gentle high-tech electrical activation pulse. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A VIDA RECONQUISTOU O CONCRETO.

Solarpunk sci-fi trailer cinematography in 16:9. Fast-paced aerial tracking shot of ultra-light solar glider aircraft diving through massive mirror-collector canyons. A violent golden sandstorm rolls over the horizon, swallowing the outer agricultural towers. Non-verbal sound design: wind howling through glider wings, heavy percussive rising drum. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: UMA TEMPESTADE SEM PRECEDENTES.

Solarpunk sci-fi trailer cinematography in 16:9. Low-angle hero shot inside a towering bio-dome. Engineers and citizens look up as the city's central energy spire pulses with blinding emerald light, shielding the metropolis from solar radiation. Volumetric god rays. Non-verbal sound design: massive cinematic energy release BRAAM and uplifting vocal choir swell. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: RESISTÊNCIA & ESPERANÇA.

Solarpunk sci-fi trailer cinematography in 16:9. Hero title reveal: sculpted radiant bronze and moss-covered 3D typography illuminated by a blinding solar eclipse flare against the vertical skyline. Slow camera pan up. Non-verbal sound design: grand orchestral climax resolving into a pure warm brass chord. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: REVOLUÇÃO SOLAR.

narration.text: Eles disseram que a terra estava condenada. Mas nós aprendemos a colher a própria luz. O futuro não pertence às máquinas. Pertence àqueles que ousam cultivar o amanhã.
narration.voice: voz feminina brasileira madura, inspiradora, firme, calorosa e épica, estilo cinema utópico de ficção científica

blocks.text: Eles disseram que o planeta havia chegado ao fim.
Mas entre as ruínas, nós aprendemos a colher a luz.
Quando a grande tempestade solar se aproxima.
Apenas a união entre homem e natureza pode resistir.
Revolução Solar. O nascimento de um novo mundo.

audio.musicIntent: Triumphant solarpunk orchestral score with warm brass, soaring French horns, organic ethnic percussion, bright mallet synthesizers and a massive uplifting climax.
